subject: Peak soak sponsorship request — temporary promotional credit for DataSift POC
messages:
From: Alice Marshall <alice@datasift.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: ops+procurement@datasift.io
Date: 2028-10-01T16:22:00Z
Subject: Request: short-term credits for peak soak (DataSift)

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well — we’re running the production-sim POC for our ranking pipeline the week of Oct 9 and have an overnight high‑concurrency soak planned to validate tail latency and KV cache behavior. Our SREs expect a concentrated 18–36 hour window of sustained QPS that will exceed our current trial balance.

Can Redwood sponsor a small promo top‑up so we can run the full soak without hitting hard quotas? Details attached (poa + traffic profile). Rough ask: a credit buffer equivalent to ~1.2M tokens (estimate in attached spreadsheet).

We’re happy to sign a short promo agreement or accept a limited time voucher tied to the test window. If you need any technical details (sequence lengths, model variants), ping Alice or cc the SRE lead (ops+procurement).

Thanks — this soak is critical for our go/no‑go and we’d love Redwood to be a partner on the run.

— Alice Marshall
SRE Manager, DataSift
attachments: datasift_soak_plan_v1.pdf, cost_estimate_q4.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Marshall <alice@datasift.io>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-02T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short-term credits for peak soak (DataSift)

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and the detailed plan.

I looped in Camila (sales lead) and Ben (partnerships) to size the ask and confirm the approval path. Two quick clarifying questions before we move to approvals:

- Can you confirm the exact 48h window you’ll need the top‑up active? (we prefer a tightly scoped window)
- Are you running mostly embedding+generation or heavy token-gen LLM endpoints? That affects token estimate vs endpoint compute.

If you’d rather, we can approve a promo code early and lock the quota to the window you provide. Camila / Ben — any initial thoughts on sponsor amount?

— Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-03T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short-term credits for peak soak (DataSift)

Markus — reviewing the attached traffic profile. Looks like Alice’s 1.2M token estimate is reasonable given the token lengths and expected QPS. Recommendation:

- Approve a promotional credit of up to $3,000 (promo_code_DS-8473) scoped to a 48h window to be scheduled by DataSift.
- Quota rules: hard cap for the promo window, automatic rollback after 48h, and alert to ops if usage hits 85% of promo.
- Require a short acceptance email from DataSift confirming the test window and model variants to be covered.

I’m attaching a one‑page soak plan summary for the approvals call. If Jonas signs off on the spend classification I’ll issue the promo code and coordinate the activation time with Alice.

attachments: datasift_soak_plan_v1.pdf

— Camila
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-04T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short-term credits for peak soak (DataSift)

I’m OK approving up to $3,000 as a marketing/sponsorship promo to support the POC, provided we implement the safeguards Camila outlined. Please ensure:

1) Promo window is explicitly defined in the activation request (start/end times, timezone).
2) Billing tag: "DS-8473-sponsorship" so finance classifies it correctly.
3) Activation is limited to specific endpoint IDs / model variants — no global account lift.

Camila — you have the green light to generate the promo_code_DS-8473 and coordinate activation with the customer.

— Jonas
VP, Partnerships (acting approval)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Marshall <alice@datasift.io>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-10-07T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short-term credits for peak soak (DataSift)

Alice — good news. We’ve approved a limited promotional credit for your POC soak. Summary:

- Amount: $3,000 promotional credit (promo_code_DS-8473)
- Scope: applies to token usage on specified endpoints only; activation window must be provided by you and will be enforced as a 48h window (UTC times).
- Safeguards: hard quota cap, 85% alert to both teams, billing tag "DS-8473-sponsorship".
- Activation: Camila will issue the promo code and schedule the activation once you confirm the exact start/end times and model variant list.

Next steps for DataSift: please reply with the 48h start/end timestamps (UTC) and confirm the endpoint IDs/model variants. Camila will attach the promo code and a short activation summary. We’ll also provide a lightweight promo agreement to sign (DocuSign link below).

DocuSign (promo): https://docusign.com/s/redirect/DS-8473-promo
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8473

Pleasure working with you — let’s get the soak scheduled.

— Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
